name: flat_walking_end_stops
description: Flat floor, walking speeds 0.2 to 0.7 m/s, and a small cost for resting joints on their end stops
notes: Duck 4's third run (from_run_2). Like flat_walking, plus 0.05 points per step for each joint resting on an end stop (less in the last 5% of its range before it). With force motors Duck 4 learned to walk with 7 to 8 joints pressed on their stops (hips, hip sides, neck, ankles), a crouch tilted about 28 degrees; that costs him about 0.4 points per step here, while walking still pays more (at 0.2 m/s about 0.6 points per step before this cost).
